name: hn-company-formation
description: Use this skill to set up a business in Honduras in 2026 and register it for tax. It walks through the choice between acting as a persona natural con obligaciones, a comerciante individual and a persona juridica (sociedad anonima or sociedad de responsabilidad limitada), the public deed before a notary and the Registro Mercantil, the SAR Registro Tributario Nacional (RTN) in person or by pre-registration on the Oficina Virtual, then ISV, pagos a cuenta, IHSS, RAP and the municipal operating permit, and the first-year tax calendar. Trigger phrases include abrir empresa Honduras, constituir sociedad, RTN persona juridica, comerciante individual and registro mercantil.
